contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_history_entries_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `history_entries` BEGIN DELETE FROM `history_entries_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_history_entries_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `history_entries` BEGIN DELETE FROM `history_entries_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_history_entries_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `history_entries` BEGIN INSERT INTO `history_entries_fts`(`docid`, `transcript`, `label`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`transcript`, NEW.`label`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_history_entries_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `history_entries` BEGIN INSERT INTO `history_entries_fts`(`docid`, `transcript`, `label`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`transcript`, NEW.`label`); END
